## Notes

- The PR satisfies the core #318 acceptance criteria: enabled self-approval receives eligible no-branch-work review outcomes, disabled self-approval stops cleanly, and required-work or blocking outcomes do not use the approval shortcut.
- The strongest evidence is the combination of deterministic policy tests, planner validation tests, prepare/resolve self-approval provenance tests, and docs updates.
- Smallest useful follow-up: tighten `deriveReviewRequiredBranchWork()` so `false` requires either an explicit no-required-work sentinel or another clearly validated no-work signal, rather than an empty Action Items section.

## Findings

- **WARNING:** The new no-required-work classifier can treat an empty present `## Action Items` section as `source_required_branch_work=false` because `deriveReviewRequiredBranchWork()` returns `false` when the section exists and `extractRequiredReviewActionItems()` is empty. That is probably acceptable given the self-approval agent still performs the final decision, but it is slightly looser than the issue language requiring the synthesis/action items to say no required branch-change work remains.

## Summary of PR/Issue
PR #320 implements #318 as part of the stacked #314 batch. It teaches orchestration that review `NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` means no more branch mutation/review loop is useful, while still allowing `agent-self-approve` when self-approval is enabled and a trusted current-head `MINOR_ISSUES` synthesis says no required branch-change work remains. The implementation threads `source_required_branch_work` through dispatch/orchestrator handoff, re-validates provenance in self-approval, and updates prompts, workflow wiring, docs, and focused regression tests. This preserves the key safety boundary: routing metadata can trigger the gate, but approval still depends on current-head trusted synthesis checks.

@sepo-agent /answer I don't get it why it turned to be such a big PR? Consider simplify it? Also check how we simplified the pr for human decision -> self approval? (Check related merged and closed PRs

I agree this PR can be simplified.

Why it got big: #320 adds a new derived signal, `source_required_branch_work`, and threads it through dispatch, orchestrator workflow inputs, prompts, handoff policy, self-approval provenance, docs, and tests. Most of the size is regression coverage: 454 of 641 additions are tests. But the structural growth comes from classifying action-item text in [`handoff.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/926f279393b2668b8542208494fc8b6fc1d306df/.agent/src/handoff.ts#L90-L94), deriving `requiredBranchWork` in dispatch, and adding a second self-approval provenance path.

The related `HUMAN_DECISION -> self-approval` work was simplified by closing the larger intermediate attempts (#264/#265) and merging #287. The key simplification in #287 was: route on one structured review signal, `source_recommended_next_step=HUMAN_DECISION`, then let `agent-self-approve` be the decision gate. See #287’s simple handoff branch in [`handoff.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/c6aea1475ab62e459b9455fde45d8b25762b9ba0/.agent/src/handoff.ts#L477-L489) and trusted synthesis check in [`self-approval.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/c6aea1475ab62e459b9455fde45d8b25762b9ba0/.agent/src/self-approval.ts#L189-L202).

Recommended simplification for #320:

- Prefer changing review synthesis semantics instead of adding a new orchestrator signal.
- When a review has no required branch-change work but still needs an approval/judgment gate, have synthesis emit `Recommended Next Step: HUMAN_DECISION`, not `NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION`.
- Then #287’s existing route already handles it: `review + HUMAN_DECISION + self-approval enabled -> agent-self-approve`.
- Keep `NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` for true terminal states where no approval/judgment gate should run.
- Drop `source_required_branch_work`, `normalizeRequiredBranchWork`, the orchestrator workflow input, and most of the new action-item classifier plumbing from #320.

If we still want to preserve `MINOR_ISSUES + NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` as a supported route, I’d still simplify by making self-approval preflight the only place that verifies “trusted current-head synthesis says no required branch work.” The orchestrator should not need to parse action-item wording and carry that as a workflow input.
